title: (Pwn2Own) Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3150 Race Condition Firewall Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass firewall rules on affected installations of Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3150 devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of firewall rules. The issue results from improper access control during device shutdown. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of root.
